title: Use Of IT In Agriculture
definition: The integration of information technology, digital tools, precision instruments, and data analytics into agricultural value chains to optimize input usage, enhance productivity, and maximize farmer incomes.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Agriculture, E-technology in the aid of farmers) and Prelims (Government digital initiatives, e-NAM, Digital Public Infrastructure for Agriculture).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Use Of IT In Agriculture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian agriculture and rural economy
